meta.title: Health & Safety: looking after yourself, looking after each other

questions.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Health & Safety Starts with Noticing'? Select all that apply.
options: People do not want to make a fuss
questions.explanation: All of these are mentioned in the section on Health & Safety Starts with Noticing.

questions.prompt: What does the deck say most accidents have in common?
options: They happen because someone breaks a rule on purpose
They happen because someone stopped noticing
They happen because PPE was too uncomfortable
They happen because the fire alarm was off
questions.explanation: Most accidents don't happen because someone breaks a rule on purpose. They happen because someone stopped noticing.

questions.prompt: What's required in any studio where lighting equipment or stands are in use?
questions.explanation: Closed-toe shoes are required — a toppling lighting stand causes serious foot injury.

questions.prompt: Why does the deck say 'a tutor pausing a practical for a safety reason' is a good thing?
options: It's the system working as it should
It's a sign the tutor is nervous
It's an excuse to finish early
questions.explanation: When a tutor pauses a practical for a safety reason, that's not someone being precious — that's the system working as it should.

questions.prompt: Which responsibilities are yours, according to the deck? Select all that apply.
options: Return all equipment to its storage position
Submit risk assessments before any location shoot
questions.explanation: You: return equipment, report faults, submit risk assessments. PAT testing and electrical maintenance are the technician / college's job.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank: ____ cables are the most common trip hazard in broadcast environments.
questions.template: ____ cables are the most common trip hazard in broadcast environments.
questions.explanation: Trailing cables are the most common trip hazard in broadcast environments.

questions.prompt: How does the deck describe the act of reporting something that's not right?
options: Not making a fuss — saying it early
questions.explanation: Saying something is 'not making a fuss — not "telling on" anyone — just saying it, early.'

questions.prompt: What is a key point about 'What Switches Noticing Off'?
options: It applies only to certain students
It is optional and not required
It is only assessed in exams
